displayPattern: Display on an LG front-load washer with a removable drawer: OPn
meaning: Drawer not inserted: LG says the washer was started without the detergent drawer fully inserted, or the drawer was opened while the washer was running.
causes: The drawer was not fully inserted when the cycle started
The drawer was opened while the washer was operating
diySteps: Push the drawer in until it is completely seated
If it was opened during a cycle, close it fully and start the cycle again
If OPn remains with the drawer seated, request service
safetyNote: Unplug the washer (or switch off its breaker) and close the water taps before you reach behind it, handle hoses or open a filter. Water left from a recent hot cycle can be very hot, so let it cool first. Never bypass the door lock. Motor, pump, valve, sensor and control-board repairs belong to a qualified appliance technician.
proAdvice: OPn is the drawer, not a drain code and not a suds code. LG says to request service if seating the detergent drawer does not clear it.
sourceTitle: LG Front Load Washer – Error Code List (LG USA Support)
